change: Directus NOI create actions use the event context database explicitly
scope: harvest_event, sales_event, and expense_event create actions
calculateNoi and storeNoiSnapshot now accept an explicit database client while preserving existing defaults for other callers
missing action database context skips recalculation without falling back to the extension-global database
limitations: Source and mocked action evidence only; no live Directus event context was exercised.
The post-write recalculation remains best-effort; this does not add durable retry or a signed worker dispatch.
The separately configured Directus scheduled hooks retain their existing scope and identity behavior.
rollback: Revert the action/context and calculator changes; the calculator's existing module-level database default remains compatible with other callers.
